channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Natural Gas: Risk premium sustained on Gulf disruptions – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Florence Schmit highlights that TTF Natural Gas remains supported by low European storage and disrupted Gulf LNG flows. The absence of meaningful U.S.-Iran progress keeps a structural risk premium in prices, with 2026 TTF seen averaging €60/MWh in Q4.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD dips below $4,400 as Middle East tensions grow
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) posts marginal gains for the third straight day on Tuesday amid risk-off sentiment as tensions in the Middle East escalate and Oil prices rally, strengthening the case for higher interest rates in the world's major economies.

item.title: British Pound: Seen weakening against Euro on hawkish BoE pricing – ING
item.description: ING strategist Francesco Pesole reports that Sterling gained modestly, helped by Chancellor John Healey’s first major speech stressing fiscal discipline and keeping long-end gilt moves aligned with global bond selling.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Momentum builds below 155 against US Dollar - MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Teppei Ino notes that USD/JPY has fallen below the bank’s 155 forecast floor, briefly trading under 154.50 and testing key Fibonacci retracement levels.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $65.88 per troy ounce, down 0.55% from the $66.24 it cost on Monday.

item.title: Indian Rupee corrects sharply from two-month high as oil price boils
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) retreats from its two-month high against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday.

item.title: Mexican Peso: Support from real rates and US talks – Commerzbank
item.description: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank highlights that the Mexican Peso has strengthened, with USD/MXN back below 17, helped by a weaker Dollar and Mexico’s strong performance among major currencies.

item.title: Australian Dollar corrects against US Dollar, US CPI takes centre stage
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is down 0.13% to near 0.7210 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday. The Aussie pair comes under pressure as the US Dollar turns positive after a weak start.

item.title: Dow Jones futures slide as inflation, trade risks mount
item.description: Dow Jones futures fall by 0.92% to trade near 52,950 during European hours on Tuesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures decline by 0.41% to trade below 7,700, while Nasdaq 100 futures lose 0.24% to trade below 29,500.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Holds firm against Euro below 371 - Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts note EUR/HUF is trading within a base formation but continues to struggle with the 200-day moving average around 371, seen as crucial resistance.

item.title: British Pound bounces off YTD low as Yen bulls pause for a breather; bearish bias remains
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross continues to lose ground for the second straight day – also marking the fourth day of a fall in the previous five – and drops to the 207.00 neighborhood, or a fresh year-to-date (YTD) low earlier this Tuesday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Bears test support at 200-day SMA as risk appetite fades
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar extends losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, weighed by the risk-off mood amid escalating tensions in the Middle East and rising Oil prices.

item.title: Swedish Krona: Inflation surprise shifts Riksbank outlook – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team reports that softer-than-expected Swedish August inflation reduced market pricing for a September Riksbank rate hike. CPI, CPIF and CPIF-XE all undershot the bank’s forecasts, with the downside surprise described as broad-based.

item.title: Gold slides below $4,400 as Fed rate hike bets and Mideast jitters revive USD demand
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) turns lower for the third straight day after a modest intraday uptick and slides below the $4,400 mark during the first half of the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Euro: Political risks seen contained for now – Nomura
item.description: Nomura’s FX strategists note that recent AfD gains in German regional elections have had little impact on EUR/USD so far, as markets see them as local events with limited national implications.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Stabilizes below 61.8% Fibo retracement at 99.20
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) recovers its early losses and turns marginally positive during the European trading session on Tuesday. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades marginally higher to near 98.95.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike bets drive gains against US Dollar - OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong highlights that USD/JPY has broken below 155 and accelerated towards the low-154s as expectations for faster BoJ policy normalisation build, with markets nearly fully pricing a 25bp hike next week.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains support on positive GDP outlook, record reserves
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 17,670 during European hours on Tuesday. The pair loses ground as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) is drawing support from positive economic sentiment following reassuring remarks from Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Stable range with shallow gains against US Dollar – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research notes that after earlier rupee outperformance driven by intervention and inflows, USD/INR has settled around the mid-94 handle.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD holds around $66.00 buoyed by US Dollar weakness
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) is trading flat at the $66.00 area on Tuesday, holding minor gains on the weekly chart after bouncing from the mid-range of the $64.00s last week.

item.title: WTI advances above $92.00, highest since July as Hormuz tensions stoke supply concerns
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts follow-through buying for the second straight day and climbs to its highest level since July 23 during the early part of the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Forex Today: Japanese Yen extends rally, Oil prices climb higher
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, September 8:

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Inflation surprise and HUF dynamics – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky highlights that Hungarian inflation rebounded to 1.3% in August but stayed below expectations and the NBH’s forecast, with price growth seen remaining under target this year.

item.title: Euro recovers some early losses against Japanese Yen, ECB policy in focus
item.description: The Euro (EUR) claws back some of its early losses against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the European trading session on Tuesday. At press time, EUR/JPY is down 0.3% to near 178.85 even after recovering from its intraday low of 177.85.

item.title: Equities: Tech leadership with Astra boost – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Bank notes European equities were broadly flat on Monday, with the Stoxx 600 unchanged and OMX Nordic slightly higher, while Asian markets rallied in thin trading as US markets were closed for Labor Day.

item.title: Euro dips to session lows near 0.8580 following German Trade Balance data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) extends losses for the third consecutive day against the British Pound (GBP) on Tuesday, as German Trade Balance data added to evidence of the frail recovery of the Euro Area's leading economy.

item.title: Swiss Franc steadies as Fed hike expectations offset safe-haven flows
item.description: The USD/CHF pair flatlines near 0.8090 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Traders brace for crucial US Producer Price Index (PPI) and Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data later this week.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Surging oil prices lift Canadian Dollar
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trades higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/CAD pair is down 0.25% to near 1.3780 at the time of writing as the Loonie outperforms due to surging oil prices.

item.title: Euro: Range-bound risks against US Dollar with ECB focus – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes EUR/USD is holding near 1.16 as a softer US Dollar (USD) and firmer Euro-area data offset higher Oil prices.

item.title: Euro retreats below 1.1630 following the release of German Trade Balance data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is practically flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, after giving back previous gains, following the release of German Trade Balance data.
